query:
WITH active_bot AS (
            SELECT id
            FROM bots
            WHERE id = $2
              AND team_id = $3
              AND deleted_at IS NULL
        )
        SELECT $1::text AS "source_id!"
        FROM active_bot
        UNION
        SELECT $3::text
        FROM active_bot
        UNION
        SELECT c.id::text
        FROM active_bot
        JOIN comms_channels c
          ON c.channel_type = 'team'
         AND c.team_id = $3
        UNION
        SELECT cp.channel_id::text
        FROM active_bot
        JOIN comms_channel_participants cp
          ON cp.user_id = $1
         AND cp.left_at IS NULL
        JOIN comms_channels participant_channel ON participant_channel.id=cp.channel_id AND participant_channel.messaging_binding<>'whatsapp_linked_group'
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM comms_channel_agents ca
            WHERE ca.channel_id = cp.channel_id
              AND ca.kind = 'direct'
        )
